addPresetJson:
// ── Preset Header Quick-Adds ──
    @FXML private void addPresetJson(ActionEvent e)       { headersData.add(new KeyValuePair("Content-Type", "application/json")); }
addPresetMultipart: @FXML private void addPresetMultipart(ActionEvent e)  { headersData.add(new KeyValuePair("Content-Type", "multipart/form-data")); }
addPresetAccept: @FXML private void addPresetAccept(ActionEvent e)     { headersData.add(new KeyValuePair("Accept", "application/json")); }
addPresetBearer: @FXML private void addPresetBearer(ActionEvent e)     { headersData.add(new KeyValuePair("Authorization", "Bearer {token}")); }
addPresetNoCache: @FXML private void addPresetNoCache(ActionEvent e)    { headersData.add(new KeyValuePair("Cache-Control", "no-cache")); }
addPresetUserAgent: @FXML private void addPresetUserAgent(ActionEvent e)  { headersData.add(new KeyValuePair("User-Agent", "APIForge/1.0")); }
